rules.statement: Execute DISCOVER, AUDIT, MODEL, PLAN, APPROVE, EXECUTE, VERIFY, REPORT, STATE UPDATE in order.
Keep specification, contract, task, execution, evidence, verification, intended result, and observed result distinct.
Reuse compatible repository controls before creating replacements.
Invent project-specific build, test, lint, CI, deployment, or package-manager commands.
Record destructive-operation authorization explicitly and stop when authorization is ambiguous.
Use actual observations only in evidence and reports.
Preserve provenance, licensing, attribution, and existing repository history.
